meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: 它让 Claude 直接向 Gmail、GitHub、Stripe 等外部 API 发 HTTP 请求,由网关在代理处自动注入凭证,Claude 看不到凭证值;服务未连接时会返回一个连接链接。
howto.when: 当你要求读取邮件、查看 GitHub 仓库或对接其他外部服务与 API 时,它接管请求;原文明确要求不走浏览器扩展或 OAuth 命令行工具。

howto.what_en: Claude makes direct HTTP calls to external APIs such as Gmail, GitHub or Stripe; the gateway injects stored credentials at the proxy, so Claude never handles credential values, and returns a connect link if a service isn't connected.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub or otherwise interact with any external service or API. Browser extensions and manual OAuth CLI tools are explicitly not used.

say_en.note: Gateway injects credentials; calls Gmail API directly
Hits api.github.com without you supplying a token
